{"reason": "suggest-alternative-supplier (45000) is dominated by alert-planner (35000, always on time): v1's 34 switches caused all 4 stockouts (inventory-days 5.3 and 2.8 rows). I removed that branch: alert any medium+ risk when inventory-days < 8 (max observed regular lead), else monitor saves 45000 where inventory outlasts delivery.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 8))
         (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
        (else (list 'monitor))))"}
